title: Dead redundant os.exists recheck in check_golden
detail: The first `if !os.exists(path)` returns on the missing-golden path, so the identical second check is unreachable and its body empty. It is unnecessary complexity the author even admits with the /* handled above */ comment.
recommended_fix: Delete the redundant `if !os.exists(path) { /* handled above */ }` line at goldens.odin:78; the early-return above already exhausts the missing-golden case.
